1: AN ORDINANCE OF THE CITY OF MOLENA RELATING TO CONSUMPTION OF ALCOHOLIC BEVERAGES IN PUBLIC BE IT ORDAINED BY THE MAYOR AND COUNCIL OF MOLENA: It shall be unlawful for any person to serve or consume any alcoholic beverage in a street, alley, public parking lot or other area commonly used by the public, or in any public place or on any public property. All ordinances in conflict with this ordinance are hereby repealed Clerk, City of Molena Mayor, City of Mo First Reading: Adopted at Second Reading: 11,
